summary: GitHub watch excerpts remove hidden HTML and real element tags only in Markdown prose, preserving inline, indented and fenced code, including quote/list containers with four-column tab stops and partially consumed tab indentation; unclosed container fences do not protect outside prose, and script/style closing tags require exact name boundaries; preprocessing remains linear before the 600-character cut

replay.detail: No replay; new excerpts are computed when watches observe GitHub items.

compatibility.detail: The excerpt field keeps its type and 600-character bound; only its content is cleaner.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores excerpts cut before hidden HTML is removed.
